subject: Publisher onboarding: manifest validation, co-sell registration & legal preflight
messages:
From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@microsoft.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace manifest checklist + co-sell intake (next steps)

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the quick sign-up in Partner Center. I attached a short checklist we use on the marketplace side and a sample manifest that highlights the fields our validation pipeline expects. High-level notes: 

- Publisher verification link: complete the identity + billing step at the Partner Center link below. This unlocks the SKU provisioning flow.
- Manifest schema: SKU ids must match the SKU list in your offer JSON (case-sensitive). Also ensure multi-region availability flags are set if you want EU/US coverage.
- Co-sell intake: to route to the co-sell team we need the intake form (PDF) filled and the sales lead contact.
- Security proofs: a one-page SOC2 summary and the audit contact are usually sufficient for the technical gate. If you have additional artifacts we can accept redactions.

Attachments: marketplace-manifest-sample.json (sample), marketplace-checklist.pdf
Links: https://partnercenter.microsoft.com/publisher/verify?token=abc123

Can you share the current draft manifest and the co-sell intake? If possible include a proposed sales lead and the partner contact for legal. Aim to get the identity verification done this week and we can try to target an offer validation slot next Tue or Wed.

Thanks —
Alyssa Nguyen
Program Manager, Azure Marketplace
Microsoft Corporation

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@microsoft.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace manifest checklist + co-sell intake (next steps)

Thanks Alyssa — this is perfect. Attached: draft-manifest.json and our filled co-sell-intake-form.pdf. 

A few quick clarifications from our side:
- The draft manifest uses sku names built from internal product codes; we matched the skuId field to those codes. If the marketplace validation requires a different format (numeric vs. alpha), please flag which field to normalize.
- We plan to be available in US + EU; does the validation pipeline need separate manifests per region or a single manifest with availability tags?
- Legal: copying Ben Wallace from Contoso Legal (they're hosting some co-sell workshops with the Contoso pilot). We'll likely need the MSA redline window and any non-standard IP clauses up front.

Proposed sales lead: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com) — she's cc'd on this thread.

Next actions I propose:
1) Alyssa — confirm manifest schema mismatches you see and preferred skuId format.
2) Karthik — run a quick sweep of the draft against our internal offer packaging checklist (security + telemetry hooks).
3) Marissa — start legal intake once Alyssa confirms the OSV/partner identity step.

Irene Choi
GTM Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: draft-manifest.json, co-sell-intake-form.pdf

From: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@microsoft.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace manifest checklist + co-sell intake (next steps)

Irene — thanks for the fast turnaround and the attachments. I reviewed the draft and flagged a few items inline (see notes). Summary of the main items blocking automated validation: 

- skuId format: our ingest expects lowercase alpha-numeric without spaces (e.g., redwood-basic-001). Your current skuId values use uppercase internally (REDWOOD_BASIC). Please normalize; we'll accept a single manifest if you add the normalized skuId under the marketplaceSkuId key.
- region flags: single manifest with availabilityTags is fine. Add an availabilityTags array with values ["US", "EU"] for the SKUs you want published to both catalogs.
- redirect URLs: the offer needs a supportUrl + legalUrl that are fully qualified (https://...).
- co-sell lead: Marissa is good; we'll need a short one-line bio to include in our co-sell intake record.

I attached: marketplace-manifest-sample.json (annotated) and a filled-mechanic example. I also created a HubSpot record for the intake: HS-12345 — use that id on the form.

Legal preflight: for the MSA redline, ask your counsel to share a short list of required deviations. If Contoso wants us to sign any additional clauses for the pilot, we prefer to see those before the validation slot.

If you make the skuId change and add availabilityTags I can queue the manifest for a manual validation run — ping me when done and I'll slot you for Tuesday morning.

Alyssa Nguyen
Program Manager, Azure Marketplace
Microsoft Corporation
Attachments: marketplace-manifest-sample.json
Related: HubSpot:HS-12345

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace manifest checklist + co-sell intake (next steps)

Quick internal note — I pulled the draft manifest and ran it against our packaging checklist:
- Telemetry hooks: ok, but enable the marketplace logging endpoint and include request-id header for troubleshooting.
- Secrets: no secrets found in repo snippets. Good.
- SOC2 summary: we have the redwood-soc2-summary.pdf that should satisfy the marketplace gate.

Marissa — can you start the legal intake with Contoso and ask for the specific pilot constraints? I'll prepare a short runbook for the validation slot (how to reproduce a failed SKU ingest).

Karthik Iyer
Principal Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Nguyen <alyssa.nguyen@microsoft.com>, Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@contoso.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace manifest checklist + co-sell intake (next steps)

Hi Alyssa / Ben — looping in legal for the Contoso pilot. Per Alyssa's note we'll: 

- Normalize skuId to marketplaceSkuId format and add availabilityTags ["US", "EU"] tonight.
- Support URL and legal URL will be hosted at https://www.redwoodinference.com/support and https://www.redwoodinference.com/legal (will be live by tomorrow).
- I'll upload the finalized co-sell intake to the HubSpot id HS-12345 and add a one-line bio for the co-sell lead: "Marissa Cole, Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference — 10+ years scaling GTM for platform vendors."

Ben — can you confirm any special IP or data residency clauses Contoso requires for the pilot? If you can email the list of ask items we can include them in the MSA redline package.

Alyssa — when you see the updated manifest and intake I appreciate a quick validation run. Targeting your Tuesday AM slot as discussed.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
Related links: DocuSign:docusign-req-9982
